北京.name: 北京
北京.ai_briefing_zh: 北京阴天微凉，体感 16℃。记得添衣，保持好心情哦！
北京.ai_briefing_en: Beijing is cloudy and cool, feels like 16℃. Dress warmly and stay cheerful!

慈溪.name: 慈溪
慈溪.ai_briefing_zh: 慈溪阴天湿润，体感 14℃。别忘了带伞，注意保暖防潮呀。
慈溪.ai_briefing_en: Cixi is cloudy and humid, feels like 14℃. Don't forget an umbrella, stay warm and dry.

上海.name: 上海
上海.ai_briefing_zh: 上海阳光正好，体感 14℃。出门散步，享受这秋日暖阳吧！
上海.ai_briefing_en: Shanghai is sunny and pleasant, feels like 14℃. Go for a walk and enjoy the autumn sun!

广州.name: 广州
广州.ai_briefing_zh: 广州多云温暖，体感 24℃。天气有点热，多喝水解渴哦！
广州.ai_briefing_en: Guangzhou is cloudy and warm, feels like 24℃. It's a bit hot, remember to drink more water!
广州.alert: 🟧 橙色降温提示：1小时降温4℃

深圳.name: 深圳
深圳.ai_briefing_zh: 深圳多云暖和，体感 24℃。湿度偏高，注意防潮和补水哦！
深圳.ai_briefing_en: Shenzhen is cloudy and warm, feels like 24℃. High humidity, remember to stay hydrated!

杭州.name: 杭州
杭州.ai_briefing_zh: 杭州有雾微凉，体感 14℃。小心慢行，注意出行安全哦！
杭州.ai_briefing_en: Hangzhou is foggy and cool, feels like 14℃. Drive carefully and stay safe!

南京.name: 南京
南京.ai_briefing_zh: 南京阳光明媚，体感 15℃。正是出游好时光，别辜负啦！
南京.ai_briefing_en: Nanjing is bright and sunny, feels like 15℃. Perfect weather for an outing, enjoy!

成都.name: 成都
成都.ai_briefing_zh: 成都阴天舒适，气温 20℃。这样的天气最适合喝茶聊天啦。
成都.ai_briefing_en: Chengdu is cloudy and comfortable, 20℃. Perfect weather for tea and chats!

武汉.name: 武汉
武汉.ai_briefing_zh: 武汉阴天，体感 18℃。湿度稍高，别忘了保持好心情哦！
武汉.ai_briefing_en: Wuhan is cloudy, feels like 18℃. Humidity is a bit high, keep your spirits bright!

西安.name: 西安
西安.ai_briefing_zh: 西安阴天舒适，体感 18℃。早晚温差大，注意及时添衣哦。
西安.ai_briefing_en: Xi'an is cloudy and comfortable, feels like 18℃. Mind the temp change, dress appropriately.

重庆.name: 重庆
重庆.ai_briefing_zh: 重庆阴天，体感 17℃。湿度有点高，心情也要放晴哦！
重庆.ai_briefing_en: Chongqing is cloudy, feels like 17℃. It's a bit humid, keep your spirits bright!

哈尔滨.name: 哈尔滨
哈尔滨.ai_briefing_zh: 哈尔滨有霾且冷，体感仅 2℃。务必多穿，外出记得戴口罩哦！
哈尔滨.ai_briefing_en: Harbin is hazy and cold, feels like 2℃. Dress warmly and wear a mask if outside!

沈阳.name: 沈阳
沈阳.ai_briefing_zh: 沈阳多云微冷，体感 6℃。早晚温差大，记得加衣保暖哦！
沈阳.ai_briefing_en: Shenyang is cloudy and chilly, feels like 6℃. Mind the morning/evening chill, dress warmly!

昆明.name: 昆明
昆明.ai_briefing_zh: 昆明阳光灿烂，体感 16℃。风力稍大，出门别忘了防晒哦！
昆明.ai_briefing_en: Kunming is sunny and pleasant, feels like 16℃. A bit windy, don't forget sun protection!
昆明.alert: 🟧 橙色降温提示：1小时降温3℃

厦门.name: 厦门
厦门.ai_briefing_zh: 厦门阴天微凉，体感 14℃。风力不小，多穿一点注意保暖哦。
厦门.ai_briefing_en: Xiamen is cloudy and cool, feels like 14℃. It's windy, dress warmly!

青岛.name: 青岛
青岛.ai_briefing_zh: 青岛有霾又冷，体感 7℃。风大，注意保暖，外出戴好口罩！
青岛.ai_briefing_en: Qingdao is hazy and cold, feels like 7℃. It's windy, dress warm and wear a mask!

大连.name: 大连
大连.ai_briefing_zh: 大连多云偏冷，体感 7℃。天气干燥，记得多喝水滋润一下。
大连.ai_briefing_en: Dalian is cloudy and chilly, feels like 7℃. It's dry, remember to hydrate!
